active_grammar.description: What grammar is being worked on right now

secondary.description: A reinforcement concept from a prior level

active_vocabulary.description: What vocabulary is being worked on right now

journal_active.description: Whether daily journal entries are assigned

anki_retirement_threshold_days.description: Days after which cards are retired

carryover_concepts.description: Concepts from prior phase still in active practice. Read by decision-engine.md Step 0b for the carryover/regression escalation ladder; sessions_in_carryover and escalation_stage are written by CLAUDE.md State Updates step 4.

concept_id.description: skill-map key of the carried-over concept

current_approach.description: The approach currently being used for this concept (change approach on escalation, do not just intensify)

escalation_stage.description: Current rung on the carryover escalation ladder. String stage name (the tutor writes the name, NOT an int) matching decision-engine.md Step 0b/0c and system-design.md.

is_prerequisite.description: True if this concept is a prerequisite for current-phase work (raises escalation urgency)

sessions_in_carryover.description: Count of sessions this concept has been in carryover; checked against the escalation ladder in decision-engine.md Step 0b

consecutive_just_right_count.description: D-11: For restoration logic. Maintained by the tutor agent each session (CLAUDE.md State Updates step 4): incremented on a 'just-right' rating, reset to 0 after a +10% restore or on a non-'just-right' rating. 3 consecutive 'just-right' after a reduction → +10% daily_target; validate-state.py check_just_right_restore_drift FAILs when this reaches 3 with the restore unapplied.

consecutive_too_much_count.description: D-11: Count of consecutive 'too-much' homework_load_rating ratings. Maintained by the tutor agent each session (CLAUDE.md State Updates step 4): incremented on a 'too-much' rating, reset to 0 after a daily_target reduction or on a non-'too-much' rating. validate-state.py check_daily_target_tier_drift FAILs when this reaches 2 with the reduction unapplied.

current_onboarding_session.description: Current onboarding session number (1-10). Agent reads this directly; incremented at end of each onboarding session.

fluency_days_this_week.description: Number of fluency days used this week

grammar_queue.description: What grammar is next when current items are acquired

just_right_streak.description: Consecutive 'just-right' session_difficulty_rating values (DISTINCT from the D-11 homework-load consecutive_just_right_count). At 3+, preserve current calibration. Maintained by the tutor per decision-engine.md L192 / weekly-review-guide.md L75; reset on a 'too-easy' or 'too-hard' rating.

last_session_date.description: Date of most recent session (YYYY-MM-DD). Used for gap detection.

placement_validation.description: Placement validation state (active during sessions 2-4 for learners who skip onboarding)

active.description: Whether placement validation is currently active

listening_baseline_set.description: Whether the listening baseline has been established

queue.description: Validation queue — populated during session 1 for Early B+ placements. Each entry: {concept_id, priority, status, checked_in_session, notes}

total_downgrades.description: Number of concept downgrades during validation

session_number.description: Current session number (sequential counter across all sessions)

sprint.description: Sprint mode - temporary reprioritization for a deadline

study_time_budget.description: D-04/LOAD-07: Homework-only time budget. Null at init; populated at first-session. Required after session 1. Renamed from REQUIREMENTS.md LOAD-07 'available_daily_study_time' per D-04.

daily_maximum.description: D-05: Hard ceiling; check-session-log.py FAILs if homework sum > daily_maximum + today_stretch. Strawman default 60.

daily_minimum.description: D-05: Minimum daily homework minutes — SLA floor for progression. Strawman default 15.

daily_target.description: D-05: Default daily assignment budget on a normal day. Adaptive via D-11 tiered rule. Strawman default 30.

today_stretch.description: D-04: Ephemeral per-session extension above daily_maximum. Reset to 0 by post-session.sh Step 5c. Default 0.

weekly_goal.description: D-05: Weekly total target; informs weekly review. Strawman default 180.

topic_history.description: List of {topic_id, week, date_started} — tracks which weekly narrow topics have been used and when, for FRESHNESS scoring in the decision engine

vocabulary_queue.description: What vocabulary is next when current clusters are acquired

weekly_topic.description: Narrow input - weekly topic for content immersion

grammar_reinforcement.description: Which grammar concept gets extra context
